comments.value: Today i managed to fix this issue. After uninstalling and re-installing Steam, reprojection works normally again in VRChat on my Bigscreen Beyond

details:
I currently experience a variety of weird things with VRChat on my Bigscreen Beyond Headsets. I am not entirely sure if this is something you can do something about, or Bigscreen, or Nvidia.

Maybe first: i own a Bigscreen Beyond 1 and Bigscreen Beyond 2e, i tested with both and they had the same behavior. 

I use an Nvidia RTX 5080.

With Nvidia Driver Versions 610.47 and all newer ones (including newest) i experience the following:

I open SteamVR in the BSB, i open VRChat, and as soon as the EAC Banner disappears and the VRChat window pops up on my monitor, the headset completely freezes on one frame that still shows the SteamVR Dashboard with “Next Up - VRChat”. The headset is still tracking, i can see that on my monitor. SteamVR Performance graph shows no issues. The actual headset screens will stay frozen until SteamVR restart. Any other game i tested works without issues. This issue only appears to happen with VRChat. Also only with the Bigscreen Beyond, on my Quest Pro everything works fine.

With Nvidia Driver Versions 596.49 and all older versions i experience the following:

VRChat opens fine - however, in the SteamVR Video settings under “Motion Smoothing” it shows “NOT SUPPORTED”. Also SteamVR is not able to use any reprojection. if both GPU and CPU can render 90 fps, everything is good. But as soon as one of the 2 would only be able to render 89 fps (or anything lower than 90), SteamVR Performance Graph shows a pink bar, and the BSB locks onto 45 fps and is stuttering. Very bad experience. Again, only in VRChat. Any other game shows that Motion Smoothing is available, and reprojection works in other games. But also VRChat works fine on the Quest Pro, just not with the BSB

Also worth mentioning: If i open VRChat, close it, and then launch any other game, everything is messed up. It feels as if right and left eye are swapped or something. After a SteamVR restart its normal again.

Thank you for reading.

Greetings,

Airbee
title: Issues with Bigscreen Beyond (frozen screen, no reprojection)
